exposure_budget.formula: X2: rounds = ceil(10 x 6 x N / (576 P)) (POST_HOC_EXPLORATORY budget)

history.per_event_channels: stored per-event values (session-relative channels restart at each segment start)

session_mode_features.scope: inside the 50-event window; ties -> most recent occurrence

session_offset_tokens.rule: min(session_index(d) - session_index(j), 7) + 1; PAD 0; v1 behavioural session (gap > 3600 s over all raw blocks; never fence-reset)

history.window_rule: rows [max(user_start, r - (L - 1)), r] of the user's retained stream in (user_id, segment_index, position_in_segment) order

manifest_binding.content_sha256_rule: sha256 of the canonical JSON list [{table, row_count, table_content_sha256}] in the header's table order (REGISTRY_FS rules.content_sha256 = v4fs_data.fs_common.manifest_content_sha256), from the verified tables
